corrections.name: kappa_b_replica_sign
corrections.description: +1/-1 sign per (eta, phi) bin for 100 kappa_b replicas, 2018. Use kappa_b_var = nominal + sign * syst. sign from SHA-256('muon-kappa-b-v1|2018|MuonScale|kappa_b|replica|eta_bin|phi_bin'), replica 1-based, bins 0-based; LSB of digest byte 0: 0 -> -1, 1 -> +1
